CONSULTING AND SUPPORT AGREEMENT

This Agreement is entered into between Precision Analytics Inc. ("Vendor") and Acme Global Corp. ("Customer") starting April 1, 2025 and expiring April 1, 2026.

1. ANNUAL VALUE
The annual fee is $60,000.00 USD with a total liability cap of $100,000.00 USD.

2. TERMS
Auto-renewal is enabled with 30 days renewal notice and 30 days termination notice. Governing law is New York (US-NY).
